  "reasons": [
    "The listed departments identify a functional structure (E1.1). Its heads do not get training for top management positions (E3.1), so D is the intended answer.",
    "A and B are associated in the excerpts with divisional structures, but their wording is broad; the excerpts do not establish that such effects are impossible in the stated functional structure.",

        "E1.1"

      ]
    }
  ],
  "option_challenges": [
    {
      "option": "A",
      "strongest_reading": "A functional setup might incur added coordination or operating costs; the stem gives no cost details, and the excerpt's duplication-based example concerns divisional structure.",

      "convention_evidence_ids": []

    {
      "option": "B",

      "correct_under_reading": true,
      "reading_status": "reasonable_unstated",
      "convention_evidence_ids": []
    },
    {
      "option": "C",
      "strongest_reading": "It is a true positive feature of functional structure, but the stem asks for a disadvantage, so it cannot be the answer.",
      "correct_under_reading": false,
      "reading_status": "contradicts_stem",
      "convention_evidence_ids": []
    }
  ],
  "blocking_defects": [
    {
      "category": "missing_decisive_assumption",
      "detail": "The stem does not limit “disadvantage” to the textbook-listed functional-structure disadvantages. A and B have plausible broader readings, and the supplied excerpts do not rule those readings out."
    }
  ],
  "style_notes": [
    "Clarifying “Which is a disadvantage of the functional structure according to the textbook classification?” would narrow the intended scope."

      },

      "status": "contradicted",
      "false_part": "It ensures that different functions get due attention.",
      "premise_source": "excerpt",
      "evidence_id": "E2.1",
      "premise_quote": "(f) It ensures that different functions get due attention. Disadvantages:",
